VOIDBORN WRAITH — translucent wraith hovering inches above the arena floor, spectral-blue body fading at the edges, both skeletal arms thrust forward mid-dual-death-bolt-cast, two pale-blue ghost-bolt projectiles mid-air spiraling toward the player, white eye-points blazing, wisping ectoplasm-trails streaming behind its arms, lower body dissolving into shadow-mist.

HEXWITCH COVEN-LEADER — witch on the arena floor mid-cast with pointed-hat, one hand thrusting a crackling green-magic-bolt mid-air toward the player, the bolt leaving a glowing-green fork-lightning-arc trail behind it, broomstick clutched in the other hand with its bristles sparking, star-and-moon embroidered cloak billowing backward, cauldron-smoke wisping around her feet.

MAGMA-ELEMENTAL — fire-elemental mid-arena in a humanoid silhouette of churning magma-and-flame, arms raised overhead with two dense lava-fireballs forming above clenched fists, ember-and-cinder particles erupting in all directions mid-air, cracks of bright-orange magma glowing between black rocky plates forming its body, eye-points blazing white-gold, standing on the floor.

GLACIAL ELEMENTAL — ice-elemental mid-arena in a jagged humanoid silhouette of compacted blue-white ice, one arm extended mid-ice-lance-launch, a spinning crystalline ice-spear mid-air with frost-particle-trail streaking behind it, razor-ice-shards radiating outward from the launch point, glowing-pale-blue eye-cores, frost-aura causing snowflake-particles to swirl around its whole body on the arena floor.

LICH SKULL-BLAST — robed lich with cracked skull-staff thrust forward mid-cast, three crackling purple-magic orbs spiraling outward from the staff-tip in a spreading arc mid-air, robes shredding at the hem, runic circle pulsing beneath hovering feet just above the floor.

CRIMSON WYRM FIRE-CHARGE — medium crimson dragon rearing on hind-legs mid-arena with wings half-spread, thick column of orange-white fire-breath erupting from open jaws and spreading into a cone mid-air, glowing-amber chest plates, clawed forelimbs swiping forward, tail-tip cracking on the floor.

FROST DRAKE BREATH — small ice-dragon crouched low mid-arena with wings spread wide, spiraling cone of blue-white frost-breath blasting forward from open jaws, frost-crystals hanging mid-air in a sparkling cloud, scales glinting silver-blue, front claws digging grooves in the floor.

MINOTAUR GREATAXE SMASH — massive minotaur mid-arena slamming a double-bladed greataxe downward, a concentric stone-debris shockwave exploding outward mid-air from the impact point, bull-horns lowered in a roar, iron-ring nose-ring swinging, hooves spread wide on the floor.

FIRE-DEMON NOVA — fire-demon crouched low mid-arena with both arms thrust outward triggering a radial fire-burst ring erupting mid-air around its body, body wreathed in churning flames, twin curved horns glowing white-hot, molten footprints scorched into the floor beneath it.

SPIDER-QUEEN WEB-SPIKE — giant spider-queen rearing on four hind-legs mid-arena, front four legs launching a volley of hardened web-spike projectiles fanning outward mid-air, multiple eyes glowing acid-green, venom dripping from raised pincers, three rear legs anchored on the floor.

SCORPION KING STING — massive scorpion-king mid-arena with segmented tail arced overhead at full extension, a crackling venom-bolt erupting from the stinger tip mid-air in a bright-green pulse, twin claws raised to the sides, chitinous legs spread low on the floor.

FOREST-SPIRIT THORN-BURST — ethereal forest-spirit mid-cast mid-arena with both translucent vine-hands spread wide, a spiraling cluster of glowing-green thorn-projectiles spiraling outward mid-air in a cone, leaf-particles shedding from its form, glowing-amber core pulsing, vine-feet rooted on the floor.

SEA-SERPENT ARC-BITE — sleek sea-serpent arcing out of a mid-arena water-pool mid-bite, a crescent of compressed-water shockwave blasting forward from the open jaws mid-air, glowing-blue bioluminescent stripe running along its body, fins flared, tail-loop still submerged in the pool.

STONE GOLEM FIST-QUAKE — massive stone-golem mid-arena with one rocky fist slamming the floor mid-impact, a burst of cracked-stone debris-cloud and concentric shockwave rings erupting mid-air from the point of contact, glowing-yellow eye-crystals lit bright, body fissures crackling with amber magic.

IRON GOLEM CHARGE-BLAST — iron-golem mid-charge across the arena floor with right arm cocked back releasing a spinning iron-shard projectile mid-air, blue-energy vents on torso blazing, mechanical rivets rattling, sparks streaming behind it, heavy feet gouging the floor with each stride.

PHANTOM WRAITH SOUL-BOLT — translucent wraith hovering just above the arena floor with skeletal arms thrust forward, a jagged blue-white soul-bolt screaming outward mid-air from both fingertips in a converging beam, ghostly body flickering, tattered shroud trailing, glowing-white eye-points burning.

BLOOD CULTIST RITUAL-BOLT — dark-priest mid-arena standing over a glowing rune-circle, arms raised firing a pulsing crimson-magic pillar upward then arcing it forward mid-air in a curving bolt, hooded robes billowing, red rune-markings blazing on chest and floor, ceremonial dagger glowing at waist.

LIGHTNING ELEMENTAL STRIKE — crackling lightning-elemental mid-arena in a humanoid silhouette of pure electricity, arms raised overhead with a branching lightning-bolt erupting downward from both fists mid-air in a forked blast, arc-discharge rings pulsing outward, ember-bright core flickering, charge building visibly at foot-level floor.
